contract: Compare the encoded metadata, recovery and dependency views with the public MOV demuxer using +noparse+nofillin.

Compare each stream's id, kind, clock, seek preroll, codec name, exact configuration bytes, language, handler, vendor, creation time and skip-samples stream side data. Creation time compares the formatted compatibility value.
Each packet folds stream index, PTS and DTS with their presence bits and raw values, duration, physical position, flags, size and every payload byte in delivery order.
Compare packet skip-samples side data and terminal EOF or refusal. Dependency flags compare as demuxed flags where SDTP contributes the disposable bit.
Input loading and schedule parsing precede the operation. Both sides open, consume and release their readers inside it.
